title: observability: token+kv logging, metrics, dashboards and alert tuning
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Reduce alert noise and improve debugging for cache regression incidents by adding token-level and KV-cache observability (metrics + tracing + structured logs), updating Grafana dashboards, and tuning alert thresholds. This PR implements instrumentation, dashboard panels, and alert refinements surfaced in ENG-1429 and ENG-1534. 

What changed: checklist:
- [x] Add token-level metrics (tokens_processed, tokens_per_request, avg_token_latency) with labels {model, route, deployment, customer_tier}
- [x] Add KV-cache metrics (kv_hits, kv_misses, kv_hit_latency, kv_miss_latency, kv_cache_size) aggregated per shard and per-deployment with reduced label cardinality to avoid high-cardinality prometheus issues
- [x] Add tracing spans for kv lookup and prefix cache retrieval; include sampling config and trace attributes for token counts
- [x] Emit structured logs for cache misses/hits and fallback paths (json logger with standardized fields)
- [x] New Grafana dashboard (dashboards/observability/token-kv-overview.json) with token-cost/latency breakdown panels and drilldowns to traces
- [x] Alert tuning: regroup previously noisy alerts into aggregated burn-rate and per-deployment high-latency alerts; add cooldowns and adaptive thresholds for scale events
- [x] Add integration tests for metric exposition and a small e2e that validates dashboard panels render data shape
- [x] Documentation: docs/observability/token-kv-metrics.md with examples and recommended alert configs

Notes on implementation details: To avoid prometheus high-cardinality, we limit route label cardinality by bucketing routes into stable prefixes and add a config flag (observability.route_label_bucket_size) for operators. KV metrics are exported at shard-level with a shard_id label; in cluster mode the exporter exposes per-pod shard summaries and a cluster-aggregator job computes global rolling windows. Tracing uses existing opentelemetry pipeline; added a new span kind 'kv_lookup' and attached token_count and cache_result attributes. Structured logs are emitted only for cache miss >= 1ms to keep log volume reasonable.

Related files changed (high level): see changed_files list below.

Testing and CI: All unit tests and integration tests passed. Prometheus metrics unit tests added to ensure no unexpected label explosion. CI recorded one transient acceptance flake on e2e run which was retried; final status: pass.

Merge notes: Squash-merged after approvals from Jonah and Priya. Backported alert tuning to release/2026-02 for immediate rollout to staging.
